dialogue.content: こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします！
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me!

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたら、声掛けさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: I'll let you know when our time is up.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。相談にお越しいただき有難うございます
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: まずはじめに、ご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか
dialogue.English: First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 38歳。女です
dialogue.English: I'm 38. Female.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 婚活中なんですけど、全然上手くいかないんです
dialogue.English: I'm actively dating with marriage in mind, but it's not going well at all.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、どんなふうに上手くいってないのかもう少しお聞かせいただけますか
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me a little more about how it's not going well?

dialogue.content: もう、3年ぐらいやっているのですが結婚まで進展していかないんです
dialogue.English: Well, I've been doing this for about three years now, but nothing ever progresses to marriage.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それは焦りも出てきますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. That must make you feel anxious...

dialogue.content: はい。子供も産みたいので
dialogue.English: Yes. Because I'd like to have children, too.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 実際どんなふうに婚活の活動をしておられますか
dialogue.English: What kind of activities have you been doing to find a partner?

dialogue.content: うーん、月に2.3回ぐらいお見合いパーティーみたいなのに行ったりしてます
dialogue.English: Hmm, I go to things like matchmaking parties about two or three times a month.

dialogue.content: なるほど、行ってみてどんな感じですか
dialogue.English: I see. What are they like when you go?

dialogue.content: 行く前は、ちょっとワクワクして行くんですが、終わるとすっごく疲れます
dialogue.English: Before I go, I feel a little excited, but by the time it's over, I'm completely exhausted.

dialogue.content: 何かちょっと期待はずれだったな、、という感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: Does it feel a bit disappointing, like it didn't meet your expectations?

dialogue.content: そういうのもあるし笑、単純に何人もの男性と会話するのもクタクタになります。
dialogue.English: There's that, too (laughs), and simply talking to so many men is exhausting.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、見ず知らずの人とたくさん話をするのはたしかに疲れてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: I understand. Talking to a lot of people you don't know can certainly be tiring...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: クタクタになって帰ってきたときはどんなことが頭に浮かびますか
dialogue.English: When you come home exhausted, what kinds of thoughts go through your mind?

dialogue.content: いいな、と思う人と連絡先の交換ができたら疲れも感じないけど、そうじゃない時はしばらく婚活は休憩しようかな、とか
dialogue.English: If I can exchange contact information with someone I like, I don't feel tired, but when that doesn't happen, I think about taking a break from it all for a while.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 上手くいかないと、がっかりしてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: It's disappointing when things don't go well, isn't it...

dialogue.content: うまくカップルになった人がうらやましい
dialogue.English: I'm envious of the people who successfully pair up.

dialogue.content: そんなのを見たら、いいなあーって思いますよね、、
dialogue.English: When you see that, it's natural to think, "That must be nice"...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、婚活を始めたきっかけとか何かあったのでしょうか
dialogue.English: By the way, was there anything in particular that made you start looking for a marriage partner?

dialogue.content: 妹の子供を見てからです。子供ってかわいいって思いました。それまであまり結婚願望もなくて、、
dialogue.English: It was after seeing my younger sister's child. I realized how cute children are. I didn't have a strong desire to get married before that...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それまではどんなふうに過ごしておられたのでしょうか
dialogue.English: How were you spending your days before that?

dialogue.content: あんまり男性と付き合うってなかったんです。コンパとかもそんなに行かなかったし。
dialogue.English: I didn't really date men much. I didn't go to mixers or group dates very often either.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それが妹さんの子供さんがかわいいのを見て、結婚を意識するようになったということですね
dialogue.English: I see. So, seeing how cute your sister's child was made you start thinking about marriage.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、結婚に対するイメージとかはどんな感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: By the way, what sort of image do you have of marriage?

dialogue.content: うーん、大変そう笑
dialogue.English: Hmm... it seems tough (laughs).

dialogue.content: でもそれをそう見せない人ってスゴイと思う
dialogue.English: But I think people who don’t make it look that way are amazing.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに思ったりするんですね
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel about it.

dialogue.content: 周りにそう思わせる人がいらっしゃるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Are there people around you who make you feel that way?

dialogue.content: そうですね。前の会社の先輩とか、友達とか。いろいろ愚痴ってはいてもなんかたのしそうだし、キラキラして見えます
dialogue.English: Yes. A senior colleague from my old company, and my friends. Even though they complain about various things, they seem to be having fun and look so radiant.

dialogue.content: 結婚している人がそんなふうに見えていたのですねでも、大変そうだな、、とも思える
dialogue.English: So that's how married people look to you. But at the same time, you also feel it seems like a lot of work.

dialogue.content: どんなところが大変そうと思いますか
dialogue.English: What parts of it seem like they would be difficult?

dialogue.content: 相手の親や兄弟とかとの関係とか、ママ友との付き合いとか。
dialogue.English: Things like the relationship with your partner's parents and siblings, or getting along with other moms.

dialogue.content: うんうん、たしかに面倒そうに思えますよね、、
dialogue.English: Yes, I can see how that would seem like a hassle...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、今はお仕事とかはされているのでしょうか
dialogue.English: By the way, are you currently working?

dialogue.content: はい。事務職です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm in an administrative job.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 結婚したら、人付き合いとか大変そうということでしたが、今のご自身の周りとの関わりはどんな感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: You mentioned that you think social relationships would be difficult if you got married, but what are your relationships like with the people around you now?

dialogue.content: 家族とも、会社関係も、友人もうまくやっていると思います。
dialogue.English: I think I get along well with my family, my colleagues, and my friends.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それが結婚してとなると色々大変そうに思える感じなのですね、、
dialogue.English: I see. So it's when it comes to marriage that those things start to seem like they'd be difficult...

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね。なんか別世界に見える
dialogue.English: Exactly. It feels like a completely different world.

dialogue.content: 別世界・・・そんなふうにも感じるのですね、、
dialogue.English: A different world... so that's how you feel...

dialogue.content: ちなみ別世界って、どんな感じなのでしょうかもう少し教えてもらえますか
dialogue.English: What do you mean by a "different world"? Could you tell me a little more?

dialogue.content: うーん、憧れ過ぎなのかなぁ。あと、結婚で失敗したくないと思いすぎているかなぁ
dialogue.English: Hmm, maybe I'm idealizing it too much. And maybe I'm too focused on not wanting to fail at marriage.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 理想のイメージが強くて、それから絶対外れたくないそんな感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: Is it that you have a strong ideal image, and you absolutely don't want to stray from it?

dialogue.content: 結婚で自分が上手くいっているイメージがない気がする
dialogue.English: I feel like I can't picture myself succeeding in marriage.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: どうしてそんなふうに感じるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: What do you think leads you to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 結婚で失敗したら、それこそ大変そうって思っちゃう
dialogue.English: If I fail at marriage, I just feel like that would be truly difficult.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、失敗が怖い、、確かにそう思いますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. You're afraid of failure... I can certainly understand that feeling...

dialogue.content: ちなみに、それは結婚してからの失敗つまり離婚したら大変ということでしょうか
dialogue.English: By the way, does that mean failure after marriage, as in, it would be tough if you got divorced?

dialogue.content: そうですね。子どもがいて離婚とかが一番心配です
dialogue.English: That's right. My biggest worry is having children and then getting divorced.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、そこはとても不安に思いますよね、、
dialogue.English: Of course, that’s a very understandable concern.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、離婚を心配するのはどういうところからなのでしょうか
dialogue.English: By the way, what is it that makes you worry about divorce?

dialogue.content: うーん、結婚が上手く行くイメージがないからかなぁ。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I guess it's because I can't imagine marriage going well.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そこがイメージできないと前に進むのが怖いですよね、、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it's scary to move forward when you can't picture that, isn't it...

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね。だから婚活が上手くいかないのかなぁ
dialogue.English: Exactly. I wonder if that's why my search for a partner isn't going well.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうかもしれませんよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that could be part of it.

dialogue.content: なんか、ショックなんですけど…
dialogue.English: That's kind of a shock...

dialogue.content: そこをもう少し考えていきたいと思います
dialogue.English: I’d like for us to explore that a bit further.

dialogue.content: 逆にそこをイメージ出来れば前に進めるかもしれませんよね
dialogue.English: On the other hand, if you could picture it, you might be able to move forward, right?

dialogue.content: 結婚が上手くいかないイメージってご自身の中でどんなのがありますか？
dialogue.English: When you picture a marriage not going well, what does that look like for you?

dialogue.content: うーん…いろんな不満が溜まってしまって、感情が爆発してどうにもならなくなり、もう離婚しかないってなりそう
dialogue.English: Hmm... I imagine various frustrations piling up until my emotions explode, things become unmanageable, and it feels like divorce is the only option.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ご自身では、結婚したら大変そうなイメージ⇒不満が爆発⇒離婚　という感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: So, in your mind, the process looks something like this: marriage seems hard → frustrations explode → divorce. Is that about right?

dialogue.content: 簡単に言ってしまえばそうかもしれません
dialogue.English: To put it simply, that might be it.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうでしたか
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I see.

dialogue.content: 結婚したら大変そうなイメージで大きそうなのは、周りの人付き合いのことでしょうか
dialogue.English: In your image of marriage being difficult, is the biggest concern about dealing with relationships with those around you?

dialogue.content: 結婚…無理かな。
dialogue.English: Marriage... maybe it's impossible for me.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、そんなことはないと思いますよ
dialogue.English: No, no, I don't think that's the case at all.

dialogue.content: 心理のお話でも、人はイメージしたとおりの人生になる　というのがありまして
dialogue.English: In psychology, there’s an idea that people tend to live the life they imagine for themselves.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今はご自身の中でマイナスのイメージが少しあるだけで、ブレーキがかかっている状態なのだと感じました
dialogue.English: I feel that right now, you simply have a few negative images in your mind, and they're acting as a brake.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 結婚のプラスのイメージがしにくいです
dialogue.English: It's hard for me to imagine the positive side of marriage.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、いきなりプラスは難しいですよね、、
dialogue.English: I understand. It's difficult to suddenly think positively, isn't it...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 少しご提案があるのですがよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: May I offer a small suggestion?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: 周りのご結婚されている方に、例えば妹さんとか、前の会社の先輩とかに心配している人付き合いとかについてもう少し情報を集めてみるのはいかがでしょうか。そうすることで、そんなに大変じゃないかもということに気づける部分もあるかもしれないし、自分なりの対応策も考えられて、少しイメージが具体的になってくると思うのですが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.English: How about gathering a bit more information from the married people around you, like your sister or your former colleague, about the social relationships you're worried about? By doing so, you might find that some parts aren't as difficult as you imagine. You could also start thinking about your own ways to handle things, which I think could help make your image of marriage a bit more concrete. What do you think?

dialogue.content: うーん、その周りの妹や先輩が大変と愚痴ってます笑。でも何とか対応しているんですよね。そうやってやっていくしかないのかな
dialogue.English: Hmm, my sister and that senior colleague both complain about how tough it is (laughs). But they're managing somehow. I guess that's just what you have to do.

dialogue.content: 今日はそこにご自身で少しお気づきなられた感じですね
dialogue.English: It seems like you've come to a bit of a realization about that yourself today.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: すみません、今日はお時間となってしまいました
dialogue.English: I’m sorry, but our time is up for today.

dialogue.content: そうですね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 婚活に頑張られているあなたを心から応援しております
dialogue.English: I'm sincerely rooting for you in your efforts to find a partner.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: もしまたお困りのことがありましたら是非この相談でお聞かせいただけると嬉しいです
dialogue.English: If you run into any more difficulties, please feel free to come back and discuss them here.

dialogue.content: はい。わかりました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: それでは本日のご相談終了とさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: Well then, we'll conclude today's session.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 大切なお話をしていただき、有難うございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing such important things with me today.

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work today!)

dialogue.content: （時間オーバーしてしまいすみませんでした）
dialogue.English: (I’m sorry for going over time.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work as well. And thank you!)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ、有難うございました！）
dialogue.English: (The pleasure was all mine, thank you!)

dialogue.content: （いえいえ、ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Not at all, thank you.)

dialogue.content: （それでは失礼いたします）
dialogue.English: (Well then, goodbye.)

dialogue.content: （はい、失礼致します）
dialogue.English: (Yes, goodbye.)
